comment: Dr. Davison is a funny guy who is very knowledgeable about music. His Cuba themed FYS is good for people that are interested in music and/or Cuban culture. Instructions for assignments can be unclear sometimes but he is always accessible by email.

Dr. Davison mixes love of jazz with an easy A. It meets late (6-8pm on tuesdays as of now) but goes by quicker than any of my other classes. Attendance is strongly preferred but Dr. Davison is willing to work with students in extenuating circumstances. He's also witty, funny, and a very affable guy. If you like music you'll like Dr. Davison.

Dr. Davison's FYS course is not good at preparing you for college writing however it is an easy A. He's not tech-savvy, so grades aren't online. Grading criteria and instructions are often unclear. Requires attending and writing about a few jazz concerts. Overall, the class is not very serious but good for an easy grade. Also Dr. D is a funny guy:)

Loved having Doc for 2 performance ensembles. Great guy, really cares about his students a lot, picks challenging music but nothing too crazy. Creates a fun environment to learn and play in, looking forward to the years to come.

Nice professor, but not clear/consistent about grading criteria. Not online savvy and does not use blackboard. Class is watching Youtube vids on random topics (usually not related to Cuba). Tries to be somewhat interactive with mandatory attendance outside of class concerts. Easy FYS, but no structure

Dr. D was a great professor for the FYS, "Where is Cuba." I do not know much about music, but the class was still enjoyable to me. I learned a lot, and it was relaxing to go to a class totally different from my other classes. His class is very engaging.

Dr. D is great. I had the chance to get to know him on a personal level. Incredibly knowledgeable, interesting and funny when lecturing. For non-music people he can be a bit of a tough grader but is for the most part is easy. Nice guy and fun to hang out with.
First year seminar "Where is Cuba" is the best FYS. Super laid back, Professor Davison loves the topic and gets super into teaching everyone about Cuban music. Should be a pretty easy A.

An extremely passionate professor who lives and breathes jazz and the culture surrounding it. Although the jokes are terrible, he is an enjoyable and genuinely nice person who will try his best to help you along in any way he can. He's a goofy fella, but watch out for those passive aggressive stingers!
